title: Magazine Street and Chartres dance spots
summary: Jones played on Chartres and Magazine with George Williams and at a popular spot Allen recalls.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. Well, I know people that... Red Hot Bergen would play his trumpet over the phone for you. Yeah. He'd play West End Blues or something like that. Did you ever play around Magazine Street and Chapitoulas and that was there? Mm-hmm.
I played on Chapitoulas at Heflers.
I don't know that. George Heflers.
Napoleonian Magazine. I played that with George Williams for a long time. You know the drummer would die. Mm-hmm.
Yeah. Then I played at Thillion Magazine. All kind of people. Even went there with a group myself. You ever heard of them having a dance spot? It was a popular dance spot, Thillion Magazine. Yeah.
Well, Lemon used to tell me about it. Thillion Magazine?

Yeah. I don't know exact neighborhood and all that. I can't remember the address but Lemon played over there he said. And they had Monkey Joe. You ever hear of Monkey Joe? Yeah. Yeah. He was playing over there. Didn't he? I think maybe the Boswell Sisters and all those people. That might have been before your time.
Yeah, it is. I don't remember. But I remember the Boswell Sisters they was on radio. Yeah. Mm-hmm.
